text: The subject, Fahad Ali, a 36‑year‑old freelance software developer, received six inbound IBFT transfers between 3 July and 9 July 2026 from six different counterparties, each ranging from PKR 32,000 to PKR 86,000 (total PKR 363,000). Within 24 hours of the last inbound payment, on 10 July 2026 he transferred PKR 218,000 in a single wallet‑to‑wallet transaction to a QuickPay wallet (WLT****0932). The following day he withdrew PKR 21,000 in cash from an ATM. The typology engine flagged the activity (score 360) for “many distinct inbound counterparties in 14 days” and “large share of inbound value leaves quickly”, both classic indicators of a border‑mule scheme. The rapid movement of the majority of the inbound funds to an untraceable e‑wallet, followed by cash withdrawal, suggests the subject is acting as a conduit for illicit proceeds. No adverse media, sanctions or PEP matches were found, and the subject has not been contacted about the suspicious pattern. Given the volume, speed, and structure of the transactions, a Suspicious Transaction Report is warranted.
